description_en: Queries the global alert configuration for Global Traffic Manager (GTM)
description_zh: 查询全局流量管理告警配置
name: DescribeCloudGtmGlobalAlert

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

`zh-CN`: Chinese

`en-US`: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

zh-CN：中文

en-US：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate a token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

DingtalkNotice.description_en:
Indicates whether a DingTalk notification is sent when an alert is triggered. Valid values:

`true`: A DingTalk notification is sent.

`false`: A DingTalk notification is not sent
DingtalkNotice.description_zh:
是否配置钉钉报警通知：

true：已配置，当报警事情发生时，会发送钉钉通知

false：未配置

EmailNotice.description_en:
Indicates whether an email notification is sent when an alert is triggered. Valid values:

`true`: An email notification is sent.

`false`: An email notification is not sent
EmailNotice.description_zh:
是否配置邮件报警通知：

true：已配置，当报警事情发生时，会发送邮件通知

false：未配置

NoticeType.description_en:
The type of the alert event. Valid values:

`addr_alert`: An address is unavailable.

`addr_resume`: An address becomes available.

`addr_pool_unavailable`: An address pool is unavailable.

`addr_pool_available`: An address pool becomes available
NoticeType.description_zh:
报警事件类型：

addr_alert：地址不可用

addr_resume：地址恢复可用

addr_pool_unavailable：地址池不可用

addr_pool_available：地址池恢复可用

SmsNotice.description_en:
Indicates whether an SMS notification is sent when an alert is triggered. Valid values:

`true`: An SMS notification is sent.

`false`: An SMS notification is not sent.

SMS notifications are supported only on the Alibaba Cloud China site (aliyun.com), but not on the Alibaba Cloud International site (alibabacloud.com)
SmsNotice.description_zh:
是否配置短信报警通知：

true：已配置，当报警事情发生时，会发送短信通知

false：未配置

仅中国站支持短信通知，国际站不支持短信通知

Threshold.title_zh: 阈值，仅突增突降类指标支持
